title: A novel method of shortening the pathway between surface reactive oxygen species and organic receptors under surface lattice metal atom substitution over HZSM-5 for intensifying catalytic oxidation CH2Cl2
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,10966-10983
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06126A, Paper
Open Access

Jian Li, Mengjie Zhao, Ziyi Song, Yingjie Shi, Tianshan Xue, Jiayu Huang, Hongchang Wang, Jinwei Zhu, Yutao Cui, Yuling Tan
Metal-doped HZSM-5 has greater catalytic performance and better resistance to chlorine poisoning and Cl deposition, due to the shortened pathway of surface reactive oxygen migration between surface reactive oxygen species and organic receptors.
